The legendary Sasha Grey talks about her passions outside of porn and how she finally took the leap to pursue them. Although Sasha has new heights in her career, she still hasn’t changed a bit since she started in the adult industry. She didn’t put herself up on a pedestal- rather, she kept her head and has remained the same person.

Sasha says she still feels like there’s so much for her to learn, and she’s constantly evolving into something better.  However, there will always be people around you that will take advantage of you.
